Lyrebirdlogic makes search and recommendation software for online marketplaces. It was founded in 2017 and has about 110 people in Sydney. Its research reading group meets every Thursday.

Bunyipstream streams live sport and events to browsers, phones and television apps, and every screen uses the same component library. - 6 to 12 years of frontend work, with React, TypeScript and HTML and CSS at an expert level (5 of 5).

React and TypeScript, Tailwind CSS tokens, Storybook, Jest, Playwright, and a monorepo with automated releases.

Bunyipstream streams live sport and events to browsers, phones and television apps. It was founded in 2015 and has about 180 people. Most engineers work from Melbourne, and a growing group works from home.
